Target.label: Plan records (in code)
Target.explain: What .aes/target.yaml declares: outcomes, rules, criteria, components and the files planned for them.

Change.label: Changing the plan (in code)
Change.explain: How the target changes: a proposal with a delta, accepted into a plan record.

Evidence.label: Evidence (in code)
Evidence.explain: Observations bound to a commit, their freshness, and the standing they give each criterion.

State.label: Current state (in code)
State.explain: What HEAD contains, how it differs from the plan, and the gaps that remain.

Context.label: Context and project records (in code)
Context.explain: Project settings, the working-context packet, the v0.1 repository context, and the project brain.

DocOnly.label: Only in documents
DocOnly.explain: Named in the goal, decisions or plans, with no code here that implements it.

External.label: Written by another tool
External.explain: Records stored here that another tool (Company Planning) writes and reads; no AES code reads them.

Retired.label: Retired (history)
Retired.explain: Removed on 2026-10-14; documents still describe it.

System.label: AES as a whole (named in documents)
System.explain: AES and its three parts as Brian names them (2026-11-11); umbrella names with no single code location.

Feedback.label: Feedback loop (in code)
Feedback.explain: The nightly loop in scripts/learning_loop that turns what happened in agent sessions into filed reports.

Lockstep.label: Lockstep (in code)
Lockstep.explain: Parts of the one planning-and-checking tool, built from proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md in six slices (merged 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-12) as package src/lockstep.

Elsewhere.label: Lives in another repository today
Elsewhere.explain: Parts of AES whose code is in another repository today (code2-template, code2-workspace).

nodes.label: Target
nodes.explain: The plan of record, .aes/target.yaml: outcomes, normative items, success criteria, components, planned artifacts and verification subjects. Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:33. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/records.py:137.

nodes.label: Outcome
nodes.explain: What an actor or consumer gets (OUT-GF-001, OUT-AP-001), with its non-goals. Defined in docs/architecture/GOAL.md:12. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/records.py:65.

nodes.label: Normative item
nodes.explain: A constraint, behavior, invariant or quality the system must hold, tied to outcomes. Defined in docs/architecture/GOAL.md:11. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/records.py:73.

nodes.label: Success criterion
nodes.explain: A checkable statement with a disproof and one or more evidence requirements; its standing decides whether it is a gap. Defined in docs/architecture/GOAL.md:11. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/records.py:86.

nodes.label: Evidence requirement
nodes.explain: One kind of evidence a criterion needs (deterministic test, runtime observation, human review or trace review); assessed one at a time, never per criterion. Defined in src/agentic_engineering_system/evidence.py:5. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/records.py:80.

nodes.label: Component
nodes.explain: A responsibility (RU-AES-*) that owns planned artifacts; `aes status` reports the first open gap per component. Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:33. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/records.py:94.

nodes.label: Planned artifact
nodes.explain: A file at an exact path that the target plans; every file under a governed root must be one. Defined in src/agentic_engineering_system/topology.py:3. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/records.py:105.

nodes.label: Verification subject
nodes.explain: The test or check (with its proof role, direct or negative control) that routes evidence to a criterion's requirements. Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:33. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/records.py:116.

nodes.label: External boundary
nodes.explain: An evidence requirement routed outside the repository (a human review, an outside system) instead of to a local test. Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:33. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/records.py:126.

nodes.label: Governed root
nodes.explain: A folder AES governs (src/agentic_engineering_system/, tests/greenfield/); only files there must be planned. Defined in AGENTS.md:33. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/records.py:198.

nodes.label: Project record
nodes.explain: .aes/project.yaml: project id, governed roots and where target, plans and observations live. Defined in src/agentic_engineering_system/topology.py:3. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/records.py:194.

nodes.label: Proposal
nodes.explain: A target delta plus the gaps it claims to close, checked by `aes plan validate` before it is accepted. Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:34. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/planning.py:168.

nodes.label: Target delta
nodes.explain: The entries a proposal adds, replaces or removes in the target. Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:34. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/planning.py:137.

nodes.label: Accepted plan
nodes.explain: A proposal applied by `aes plan accept`, kept in .aes/plans/ with the revision it was accepted at. Defined in AGENTS.md:39. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/planning.py:197.

nodes.label: Trace-review declaration
nodes.explain: A proposal's statement of whether its work runs; work that runs needs a trace-review requirement (RULE-TRACE-REVIEW-DECLARED). Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:27. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/planning.py:148.

nodes.label: Observation
nodes.explain: An append-only evidence record in .aes/observations/, bound to the commit it observed and the paths and target entries it depends on. Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:35. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/evidence.py:184.

nodes.label: Assessment
nodes.explain: An observation's verdict on one evidence requirement: SUPPORTS, REFUTES or INCONCLUSIVE. Defined in src/agentic_engineering_system/evidence.py:5. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/evidence.py:104.

nodes.label: Negative control
nodes.explain: A case a control should refuse, recorded with whether it was detected; controls must prove they can fail (AES-POL-004). Defined in docs/architecture/GOAL.md:23. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/evidence.py:120.

nodes.label: Freshness
nodes.explain: CURRENT, STALE, UNKNOWN or UNREACHABLE, computed from Git: an observation is stale once a path or entry it depends on changes after its commit. Defined in src/agentic_engineering_system/evidence.py:9. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/evidence.py:384.

nodes.label: Criterion standing
nodes.explain: SUPPORTED, REFUTED or INSUFFICIENT for each criterion; only current assessments count, and ignorance never renders green. Defined in docs/architecture/GOAL.md:21. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/evidence.py:434.

nodes.label: Characterization
nodes.explain: What HEAD contains under the governed roots: each file's blob and its Python symbols. Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:36. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/characterize.py:61.

nodes.label: Drift
nodes.explain: A planned artifact whose committed symbols or signatures no longer match the target (formatting alone is not drift). Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:18. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/characterize.py:208.

nodes.label: Orphan
nodes.explain: A tracked file under a governed root that the target does not plan; `aes topology check` fails on it. Defined in src/agentic_engineering_system/topology.py:3. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/topology.py:73.

nodes.label: Gap
nodes.explain: An unmet criterion or requirement that stays open until fresh evidence supports it. Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:22. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/reconcile.py:113.

nodes.label: Reconciliation
nodes.explain: `aes status` / `aes reconcile`: artifacts, criteria, observations and plans composed into current state and first gap per component. Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:43. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/reconcile.py:259.

nodes.label: Legacy baseline
nodes.explain: `aes adopt`: today's governed files in an existing repository accepted as legacy, without claiming conformance. Defined in docs/architecture/GOAL.md:61. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/adopt.py:48.

nodes.label: Working context
nodes.explain: `aes context <subject>`: the smallest complete packet of full-text rules and criteria for one subject, with what was left out listed. Defined in src/agentic_engineering_system/context.py:1. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/context.py:72.

nodes.label: Pre-commit hook
nodes.explain: The hook `aes hooks install` writes; it refuses a commit that leaves an orphan under a governed root. Not running in this checkout since 2026-10-13: core.hooksPath runs lefthook, which never calls aes (Q16). Defined in AGENTS.md:39. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/hooks.py:83.

nodes.label: Repository context (v0.1)
nodes.explain: The v0.1 Plan 001 artifact: authority surfaces and concern roots resolved from a checkout, with unresolved surfaces kept visible. Defined in docs/plans/001_repository_context_resolution_vertical.md:1. Code: src/agentic_engineering_system/repository_context/models.py:87.

nodes.label: Project brain
nodes.explain: The .project-brain/ files (now, state, truth, project) an agent reads first; a script reports when they are older than the work since. Defined in CLAUDE.md:5. Code: scripts/hive/brain_fresh.py:35.

nodes.label: Checked-boundary thesis
nodes.explain: The bet that agent-built software stays true to intent when every claim is checked against something an agent cannot talk past; with its disproof, still unmeasured. Defined in docs/architecture/GOAL.md:42. No code.

nodes.label: Colleague starts a new project
nodes.explain: OUT-GF-001's north star: a colleague without private repositories takes a new project from intent to evidence-backed state. Defined in docs/architecture/GOAL.md:37. No code.

nodes.label: Value tally
nodes.explain: Decision 0011's pre-registered measure: AES catches versus hand checks a person still needed (whygame5: 1 catch, 6 hand checks). Defined in docs/decisions/0011-inside-success-aes-archived-canonical-is-aes.md:64. No code.

nodes.label: Offline policy-decision replay (v0.1)
nodes.explain: Plan 002, the v0.1 frontier, stopped at its provider-access step; no code here implements it. Defined in docs/plans/002_offline_policy_decision_replay.md:3. No code.

nodes.label: Plan adoption receipt
nodes.explain: A Company Planning adoption record (*.receipt.json next to a plan in docs/plans/ or proposals/), naming the bounded-design profile revision the plan was adopted under; distinct from an AES accepted plan. Defined in docs/plans/adoption-progress-fields.receipt.json:1. No code.

nodes.label: Commit rule
nodes.explain: Commit tags and plan adoption per commit; removed on 2026-10-14 at Brian's request. .aes/commit_rule.yaml remains, read by no code. Defined in docs/model/ODD.md:55. No code.

nodes.label: AES (the whole system)
nodes.explain: The whole agent system: Lockstep, the feedback loop and the policy layer; its parts live where they are. Defined in CLAUDE.md:14. No code.

nodes.label: Policy layer
nodes.explain: Brian's rules for agents and the register of how each is enforced: the AES rules register here and the core rules and topic files in code2-workspace agents/. Defined in .project-brain/now.md:9. No code.

nodes.label: Feedback loop
nodes.explain: The nightly collector and labels jobs: read changed Claude and Codex transcripts, extract corrections, friction and learnings, file reports, label them. Defined in scripts/learning_loop/systemd/README.md:3. Code: scripts/learning_loop/collect_feedback.py:518.

nodes.label: Human correction
nodes.explain: Something Brian told an agent that says it was wrong or should work differently, extracted from a transcript with its quote. Defined in scripts/learning_loop/collect_feedback.py:81. Code: scripts/learning_loop/collect_feedback.py:85.

nodes.label: Feedback report
nodes.explain: One issue in the private agent-feedback-log; a report from a human correction carries the label source:human. Defined in scripts/learning_loop/systemd/README.md:16. Code: scripts/learning_loop/feedback_log.py:212.

nodes.label: Rules register
nodes.explain: docs/rules/register.yaml and the page generated from it: each published rule, its status and how it is enforced. Defined in docs/rules/RULES.md:3. Code: scripts/rules/build_rules_page.py:207.

nodes.label: Agent rules (core and topic files)
nodes.explain: The rules every Claude Code and Codex session loads, with Brian's words behind each in rule-sources.md; in code2-workspace agents/. Defined in .project-brain/now.md:9. No code.

nodes.label: pcw (Lockstep's old name)
nodes.explain: The old package name, kept as an alias of lockstep so lifelike's Makefile and Team-Brains' runner keep working until they move; the old lockstep repository is kept as history. Defined in src/pcw/__init__.py:1. Code: src/pcw/__init__.py:8.

nodes.label: code2check
nodes.explain: code2-template's commit checks (trace, arch, test-first, sources, docmeta) run in every code2 repository's make check. Defined in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md:46. No code.

nodes.label: Lockstep, the one planning-and-checking tool
nodes.explain: One installable package shipped from this repository, one config file, one plan format, one edit guard and one commit check; any repository installs it with one command (`lockstep init`, src/lockstep/init_repo.py). Defined in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md:14. Code: src/lockstep/check.py:398.

nodes.label: lockstep.yaml
nodes.explain: The one config file: which checks block, warn or are off, governed and fixed paths, layout rows, the human-source pattern and the owner; names no machine path. Defined in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md:55. Code: src/lockstep/side_file.py:136.

nodes.label: Layout row
nodes.explain: One planned file in lockstep.yaml: its path, purpose, the requirements it implements and the tests that prove it. Defined in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md:25. Code: src/lockstep/layout_plan.py:60.

nodes.label: OpenSpec requirement
nodes.explain: A requirement with scenarios in openspec/specs/, written and archived with the openspec tool; the one tool's format for what the code must do. Defined in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md:40. No code.

nodes.label: First docstring
nodes.explain: The docstring lockstep layout writes at the top of each planned file: the requirement text, its success criteria and test names. Defined in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md:28. Code: src/lockstep/cogtext.py:72.

nodes.label: Edit guard
nodes.explain: The one edit-time hook: refuses a write to a file the plan does not name and shows the plan; allows reading a planned file. Defined in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md:30. Code: src/lockstep/hook.py:474.

nodes.label: lockstep check
nodes.explain: The named commit checks ported from code2check: trace, arch, test-first, sources, docmeta; each set to block, warn or off. Defined in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md:72. Code: src/lockstep/checks/cli.py:191.

nodes.label: lockstep plan check
nodes.explain: The plan and acceptance format check ported from Company Planning's validator, so the format is defined in one place. Defined in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md:74. Code: src/lockstep/plan_check.py:363.

nodes.label: Acceptance entry
nodes.explain: One outcome Brian judges by hand: criterion, steps on a working page, what he should see, a known broken case (docs/planning/acceptance-criteria.json). Defined in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md:42. No code.

nodes.label: Slice
nodes.explain: One step of the one-tool build that merges when it works: move, plan format, guard, commit checks, plan check, switch users. Defined in proposals/one-planning-tool/DESIGN.md:64. No code.
